diagnoses.analysis: build / common / test3 (27, hotspot) fails the PR-added ThreadDetailsCustomizerProviderTest for absent and explicit-false settings. All frozen failed tests are the same ClassCastException at the ReadableSpan cast. With exporters set to none and no thread-details processor, the SDK returns a non-recording PropagatedSpan. The candidate adds SimpleSpanProcessor with InMemorySpanExporter and checks exactly one exported span with the complete expected attributes, retaining all three setting cases and production defaults. The original failure was reproduced locally, and the fixed focused test, full tooling suite, declarative distribution suite, formatting/checkstyle, and deny-unsafe focused test pass on Java 25. Local latest-dependency validation was attempted but stopped before tests because an unrelated Helidon project requires Java 27 and toolchain provisioning failed certificate validation; that check is not claimed to have passed. metadata.body:
<!--
CHANGELOG.md is generated from merged pull requests. Do not add an entry unless this PR introduces
a deprecation or breaking change.
-->

Related to #20510 — group 11 only.

Makes process command resource attributes and Java agent thread details default-off independently of `otel.instrumentation.common.v3-preview`. Explicit opt-ins and opt-outs remain supported.

- **Defaults:** Gate process command attributes solely on their dedicated setting; align flat thread-detail defaults with declarative distribution behavior. Preserve other process attributes.
- **Coverage:** Test absent, enabled, and disabled flat settings; consolidate obsolete process preview cases.
- **Documentation:** Update resource usage, metadata, and breaking-change migration notes.

To retain capture:

```properties
otel.instrumentation.resources.experimental.process-command-attributes.enabled=true
otel.javaagent.add-thread-details=true
```

No unrelated selectors, instrumentation names, or shared preview helpers change.
metadata.title: Make process command attributes and agent thread details opt-in for 3.0
